name: Map64_GetValue

name: Map64_SubRemoveIfZero
comment: [IN] subtrai qtd; remove o slot e desloca se zerar

name: AddClampedCounter
comment: [IN] soma ao dinheiro u32 0x03002B70 com teto 99999

name: SubClampedCounter
comment: [IN] subtrai do dinheiro com piso 0

name: Event_Op36_GetItem
comment: [IN] evento 0x36 GetItem setup: args id,qtd

name: Event_Op36_Cont_GetItem
comment: [IN] 0x36 continuacao: teto 99, mensagem cheio/recebeu

name: EventOpcode37_LoseItem

name: EventOpcode3A_GetMoney
comment: [IN] 0x3A GetMoney: arg*10 somado ao dinheiro

name: EventOpcode3B_LoseMoney
comment: [IN] 0x3B LoseMoney: arg*10, piso 0

name: Event_Op4B_Jump_If_Item_Count_Below_Amount

name: Event_Op4E_Jump_If_Not_Has_Money
comment: [IN] 0x4E: salta se dinheiro < arg*10

name: Event_Op59_Open_Shop
comment: [IN] 0x59 setup: le id da loja (1 byte) e marca estado

name: Event_Op59_Cont_OpenShop
comment: [IN] 0x59 continuacao: roda cena 3 (abre loja) e termina

name: Inventory_GetItemCount
comment: [IN] wrapper de Map64_GetValue

name: gMoney

name: gItemInventory

name: Shop_BuildItemList64

comment: [IN] provavel MENU DE DEBUG: contadores 0..0x3F e dar itens (confirmar)
